attrs.author: Deepseek
attrs.summary: DeepSeek-V2, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model characterized by economical training and efficient inference. DeepSeek-V2 adopts innovative architectures including Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE. MLA guarantees efficient inference through significantly compressing the Key-Value (KV) cache into a latent vector, while DeepSeekMoE enables training strong models at an economical cost through sparse computation.
